def factor_volume_ratio_pressure(df):
    """
    Directional pressure (intraday - overnight return) smoothed with EWMA(10),
    then scaled by the continuous volume ratio (clipped to [0.7,1.2]) instead
    of binary high/low flags. Higher relative volume amplifies the signal
    smoothly, reducing regime-switching noise.
    """
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(
        df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"]
    )
    raw_pressure = intraday_ret - overnight_ret
    smoothed_pressure = raw_pressure.ewm(span=10, min_periods=10).mean()
    is_high, is_low, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(
        df_copy["volume"], window=20, high_threshold=1.5, low_threshold=0.6
    )
    vol_scale = vol_ratio.clip(0.7, 1.2)
    factor = smoothed_pressure * vol_scale
    df_copy["factor_volume_ratio_pressure"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_volume_ratio_pressure"]
description: The core directional pressure signal (smoothed intraday-minus-overnight return spread) is scaled by the continuous volume ratio, clipped to [0.7, 1.2], instead of binary high/low volume flags. This provides a smoother, more robust scaling that retains the idea that higher volume confirms conviction while reducing regime-switching noise.
